author: qduoduo-hwh
description: MCP server for pictostl.com image-to-3D generation
name: PicToSTL

tools.name: list_generation_options
tools.description: List pictostl.com generation options available to API clients: quality (Basic/Pro/Ultra), texture, single vs multi-view rules, and credit costs.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload a local image file or HTTPS URL and return an assetId for generate_model. Do not pass this id to download_model or get_task.

path.description: Local filesystem path to an image file

tools.name: generate_model
tools.description: Start an async image-to-3D job on pictostl.com. Requires imageAssetIds from upload_image. If you omit clientRequestId the server call still sends one — reuse that value to retry the same job without a second charge. Poll with get_task using the returned task id.

views.description: Required for Pro/Ultra multi-view; must include Front

clientRequestId.description: UUID for idempotent retries; generated when omitted

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Fetch a generation by task id (not an upload assetId). Optional waitSeconds (max 60) polls until completed or failed. Jobs often take longer than 60 seconds — call again with the same id until it is completed or failed.

waitSeconds.description: Seconds to poll for a terminal status (max 60)

tools.name: list_my_generations
tools.description: List recent 3D generations for this API key's user.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show remaining credits and whether Pro / Ultra can be paid with non-trial credits.

tools.name: download_model
tools.description: Download a completed generation to a local path. id is the task id from generate_model/get_task, not an upload assetId. format stl (default) converts the original GLB locally to binary STL with longest edge 100 mm (no color/texture). format glb writes the original file. Parent directory must already exist.

id.description: Task id from generate_model or get_task
